skills.name: aso-atlas
skills.description: App Store Optimization with ASO Atlas. Use for App Store keyword research (popularity, difficulty, who ranks), tracking an iOS app's keyword rankings per storefront, competitor keyword gaps, metadata (title, subtitle, keyword field) drafts, and questions like "how is my app doing" answered from App Store Connect data. Requires the ASO Atlas MCP server (asoatlas.com/mcp).
